Project Technical Support-III, Project Technical Support-I

rows.date: To be communicated to shortlisted candidates via email

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Delhi Vacancy Details (Post-wise)
content_sections.text: The recruitment offers a total of 2 vacancies under the ICMR extramural project.

rows.qualification_required: Essential: Three Years Graduate Degree Psychology/Clinical psychology/Social work + three Years post qualification experience; OR Post Graduate Degree in Psychology/Clinical psychology/Social work. Desirable: Training in emerging technologies and methodologies for knowledge management and communication would be an asset. Experience working in the area of information and knowledge management and/or communication projects in oncology.

Essential: Three Years Graduate Degree Psychology/Clinical psychology/Social work + One Years post qualification experience. Desirable: Knowledge of IT applications, MS excel and words. Experience in performing data entry, data cleaning, and generating queries.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Delhi Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process comprises shortlisting of candidates followed by a walk-in-interview.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS Delhi Recruitment
content_sections.text: Open the application form using the provided link or scan the QR code given in the official notification. Fill in all required details accurately in the online form. Submit the completed application form on or before 20 October 2026, 10:00 PM. Note down any confirmation details for future reference.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Delhi Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Only shortlisted candidates will be invited for the walk-in-interview. No TA/DA will be provided for attending the interview. Reservation policies, including age relaxation, will be applied in accordance with the prevailing Government of India guidelines. The time and venue of the interview will be communicated to shortlisted candidates via email. For any query, candidates may contact [email protected] .

faq.question: Q1. What is the organisation conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: All India Institute of Medical Sciences Delhi (AIIMS Delhi) is conducting this recruitment for an ICMR funded project.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available under this notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application is 20 October 2026 at 10:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for Project Technical Support-III?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Three Years Graduate Degree in Psychology/Clinical psychology/Social work with three years post qualification experience, or a Post Graduate Degree in Psychology/Clinical psychology/Social work.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification required for Project Technical Support-I?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Three Years Graduate Degree in Psychology/Clinical psychology/Social work plus one year of post-qualification experience.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for Project Technical Support-III?
faq.answer: The salary is Rs. 28,000/- plus 30% HRA per month.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates are required to fill out the application form using the online link or QR code provided in the notification.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Candidates will be selected through shortlisting followed by a walk-in-interview.

faq.question: Q10. Will I get TA/DA for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No TA/DA will be provided for attending the interview.
